capabilities: highlight the yanked text region with a subtle animation
extras: Installation is also documented for manual setup via release zips placed in the plugins folder.
intentEvidence: There is already a yank highlighter plugin, but it relies on monkey-patching the codemirror-vim code which I wanted to avoid.
motivation: The author wanted yank highlighting without the monkey-patching of the codemirror-vim code used by an existing yank highlighter plugin.
problem: Obsidian's Vim mode, built on CodeMirror's vim implementation, has no native support for visually highlighting yanked text, and it is unlikely to be added.

relations.evidence: The Vim mode in CodeMirror lacks native support for highlighting yanked text

summary: Vim mode enhancement that briefly highlights the yanked text region with a subtle animation after a yank operation.
